changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionParameter_MetricAssetVersion') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionParameter] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionParameter_MetricAssetVersion] END

END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionParameter_MetricAssetVersion') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionParameter] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionParameter_MetricAssetVersion] FOREIGN KEY([Uid], [EffectiveDate]) REFERENCES [metrics].[AssetVersion] ([Uid], [EffectiveDate]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionParameter] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionParameter_MetricAssetVersion] END
